skills.description: Chat through a governed DDK LLM proxy. Set metadata {'proxy': '<name>'} to pick a chat-compatible proxy (default ddk-openai-model-routing); optional metadata {'model': '<name>'} to override the requested model, {'history': [...]} for prior turns.
